Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the spread of invasive plant species in Washington.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to addressing the spread of invasive plant speciesin Washington; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By December 31, 2009, the state noxious weedcontrol board shall amend WAC 16750003 as necessary to ensure thatits definitions of the terms "control," "contain," and "prevent thespread of noxious weeds" adequately address the spread of noxious weedsby seed as well as other reproductive propagules. At a minimum, theboard must ensure that these definitions adequately address the spreadof Bohemian knotweed (Polygonum bohemicum), giant knotweed (Polygonumsachalinense), Himalayan knotweed (Polygonum polystachyum), andJapanese knotweed (Polygonum cuspidatum) by propagules including, butnot limited to, rhizomes or fragments.
